author: Daniel Defoe
title: The Life and Adventures of Robinson Crusoe
edition: London, 1808 edition explicitly dated in the source title matter, Project Gutenberg 12623 transcription. Novel text only: the separate biographical introduction, illustrations and editorial apparatus are excluded. Prose hard-wrap newlines reflowed; paragraph boundaries, historical spelling and punctuation retained.

rights.basis: The original-English text in this 1808 edition was published well before 1931 and its US term has expired. The named Project Gutenberg catalogue explicitly records public domain in the USA.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg 12623 plain text (UTF-8) from the PG mirror aleph.pglaf.org. Kept the narrative from its title (THE / LIFE AND ADVENTURES / OF / ROBINSON CRUSOE, / &c. &c., joined as one level-1 heading) to the last paragraph; removed the PG header and footer, the frontispiece illustration marker, G.D.'s biographical Life of De Foe with its footnote, and the rows of asterisks. Prose lines joined with single spaces, _underscores_ kept for italics; THE JOURNAL. is a level-2 heading; indented prose (Crusoe's N.B. notes and the bracketed asides in the Atkins dialogue) is joined as paragraphs; the Evil and Good account is one paragraph with a tab between the columns of each printed row (each column's wrapped lines joined); the seasons table, the casualty and company lists and the quoted couplets are stanzas with leading indentation removed.
